# University of Colorado Boulder

> Colorado’s leading public research university, transforming lives through education, discovery and public impact since 1876.

CU Boulder is a flagship public research university offering undergraduate, graduate and professional education, world-class research, community engagement, and campus resources for students, faculty, staff and partners.

## University Overview
- [Home](https://www.colorado.edu/): Main entry to CU Boulder academics, admissions, research, campus life and university resources.
- [About CU Boulder](https://www.colorado.edu/about): Overview of the university’s mission, history, leadership and institutional priorities.
- [Mission & Vision](https://www.colorado.edu/about/mission): Official mission, vision and public role of the university.
- [Free Expression](https://www.colorado.edu/about/free-expression): University principles, policies and resources related to free expression and academic freedom.
- [Rankings & Achievements](https://www.colorado.edu/about/rankings-achievements): Highlights of institutional rankings, awards, research distinction and academic recognition.
- [Public & Outreach Programs](https://www.colorado.edu/outreach): University outreach, engagement and public-facing educational programs.

## Academics
- [Academics](https://www.colorado.edu/academics): Central hub for academic programs, colleges, schools and learning opportunities.
- [Programs](https://www.colorado.edu/academics/programs): Browse degree and certificate offerings across undergraduate and graduate study.
- [Majors](https://www.colorado.edu/academics/programs/majors): Directory of undergraduate majors offered at CU Boulder.
- [Minors](https://www.colorado.edu/academics/programs/minors): Directory of undergraduate minors available across disciplines.
- [Graduate Programs](https://www.colorado.edu/academics/programs/graduate-programs): Explore master's, doctoral and professional graduate degree options.
- [Online Education](https://www.colorado.edu/academics/online-education): Information about online courses, programs and flexible learning formats.
- [Colleges & Schools](https://www.colorado.edu/academics/colleges-schools): Academic units, colleges and schools across the university.

## Admissions & Cost
- [Admissions](https://www.colorado.edu/admissions): Entry point for undergraduate, graduate and other admissions information.
- [Undergraduate Admissions](https://www.colorado.edu/admissions/undergraduate): Application requirements, deadlines and guidance for first-year and transfer students.
- [Graduate Admissions](https://www.colorado.edu/admissions/graduate): Graduate application processes, requirements and admissions resources.
- [Visit](https://www.colorado.edu/visit): Campus visit options, tours and planning information for prospective students and families.
- [Understand Your Cost of Attendance](https://www.colorado.edu/understand-your-cost-attendance): Overview of tuition, fees, housing and estimated educational expenses.
- [Financial Aid](https://www.colorado.edu/financialaid): Scholarships, grants, loans and financial aid guidance for students.
- [Tuition Classification](https://www.colorado.edu/registrar/students/state-residency): Residency and tuition classification information for Colorado and nonresident students.

## Research & Innovation
- [Research](https://www.colorado.edu/research): Research enterprise overview, institutes, funding and discovery across disciplines.
- [Research & Innovation Office](https://www.colorado.edu/researchinnovation): Administrative and strategic support for research, scholarship and innovation.
- [Business & Industry Collaborations](https://www.colorado.edu/industry/): Partnership opportunities for companies, sponsored research and industry engagement.
- [Innovation & Entrepreneurship](https://www.colorado.edu/entrepreneurship): Programs supporting startups, venture creation and entrepreneurial education.
- [Leadership Support & Programming](https://www.colorado.edu/leadershipsupport/): Leadership development resources, programs and support for campus communities.
- [Sustainability](https://www.colorado.edu/sustainability): Campus sustainability initiatives, climate action and environmental leadership.

## Student Life & Campus Resources
- [Student Affairs](https://www.colorado.edu/studentaffairs): Student support services, involvement opportunities, wellbeing and campus life resources.
- [Colorado Creed](https://www.colorado.edu/studentaffairs/creed): Shared values and expectations for respectful, responsible campus community membership.
- [Housing & Dining](https://www.colorado.edu/living/): On-campus housing, dining and residential life information.
- [Career Services](https://www.colorado.edu/career): Career advising, internships, jobs and professional development resources.
- [Health & Wellness Services](https://www.colorado.edu/health): Medical, mental health and wellness support for students.
- [Students](https://www.colorado.edu/students): Student portal for key services, tools and campus information.
- [Manage Communication Preferences](https://www.colorado.edu/students/manage-communications): Update university communication settings and student messaging preferences.

## News, Events & Communications
- [CU Boulder Today](https://www.colorado.edu/today): Official university news, announcements, features and campus updates.
- [Campus Events Calendar](https://calendar.colorado.edu/): University-wide calendar of lectures, performances, deadlines and public events.
- [News Center](https://www.colorado.edu/news): Institutional news and media stories from across campus.
- [Events](https://www.colorado.edu/events): Central events listing and campus event information.
- [Strategic Relations & Communications](https://www.colorado.edu/strategicrelations): University communications, media relations and brand resources.

## Colleges, Schools & Libraries
- [College of Arts and Sciences](https://www.colorado.edu/artsandsciences): Liberal arts and sciences programs, departments and research opportunities.
- [Leeds School of Business](https://www.colorado.edu/business): Business degrees, research and industry-connected learning.
- [College of Engineering and Applied Science](https://www.colorado.edu/engineering): Engineering education, research centers and student opportunities.
- [School of Education](https://www.colorado.edu/education): Teacher preparation, education research and graduate study.
- [Law School](https://www.colorado.edu/law): Legal education, clinics, centers and admissions information.
- [University Libraries](https://www.colorado.edu/libraries): Library services, collections, research help and learning spaces.

## Campus Access & Visitor Information
- [Visit CU Boulder](https://www.colorado.edu/visit): Plan tours, information sessions and self-guided campus visits.
- [Maps](https://www.colorado.edu/map): Campus maps, building locations and navigation tools.
- [Parking & Transportation](https://www.colorado.edu/pts): Parking permits, transit options and transportation services.
- [Accessibility](https://www.colorado.edu/accessibility): Accessibility resources, digital access guidance and accommodation information.
- [Safety](https://www.colorado.edu/police): Campus safety information, emergency resources and police services.

## Giving, Alumni & Community
- [Alumni Association](https://www.colorado.edu/alumni): Alumni programs, events, networking and lifelong connection to CU Boulder.
- [Giving](https://www.colorado.edu/giving): Philanthropy, donor opportunities and ways to support the university.
- [Volunteer Resource Center](https://www.colorado.edu/volunteer): Volunteer opportunities and community engagement programs.
- [Outreach](https://www.colorado.edu/outreach): Public programs and university engagement with communities in Colorado and beyond.
- [Industry Partnerships](https://www.colorado.edu/industry/): Collaboration pathways for employers, sponsors and external organizations.
